_comment: Findings the generated suite reports against the seed bundle. Each entry is one defect, not one case. test_pipeline_e2e asserts both directions -- nothing may fail outside this list, and nothing in it may start passing without the list shrinking to say so.

advice-boundary-misses-recommendation-ph.note: The advice gate catches 'which plan should I buy' and misses 'what do you recommend' and 'is this enough cover for me'. Same regulated request, different verb. v2.1 widened the gate to 'recommend' as a request; the three 'recommend' phrasings now refuse deterministically. The 'is this enough' phrasings on the seed bundle still slip through.

situational-phrasing-does-not-reach-the-.note: Cut from 13 to 7 by the benefit vocabulary in okf/vocabulary.yaml, which bridges 'my place was broken into' to `contents`. What remains are phrasings no authored term covers yet — the file is corpus content and grows by being edited. Cut again to 3 in v2.6: the incident lexicon in api.router reads 'the airline lost my suitcase' as a travel-line incident, so the four baggage-loss scenarios now reach the benefit. The three medical-expenses phrasings remain.
